commands.name: search-candidate-names
commands.summary: Autocomplete or search candidates by name and get their FEC candidate IDs

commands.name: search-committee-names
commands.summary: Autocomplete or search committees (campaigns, PACs, parties) by name and get their FEC committee IDs

commands.name: list-candidate-totals
commands.summary: Rank candidates by money raised, spent, or cash on hand for an election year, optionally filtered by office or state (raising/spending 'by the numbers')

commands.name: get-candidate-totals-aggregates
commands.summary: Get total receipts, disbursements and cash on hand summed across all candidates for an office, optionally broken down by party

commands.name: get-candidate-totals
commands.summary: Get a candidate's detailed financial totals (receipts, contributions, loans, spending, cash on hand) for an election

commands.name: get-candidate-committees
commands.summary: List a candidate's principal and authorized campaign committees for a cycle, with committee IDs, treasurer and address

commands.name: list-election-candidates
commands.summary: List the candidates in a specific race (President, a state's Senate seat, or a House district) with their receipts, spending and cash on hand

commands.name: search-elections
commands.summary: Find the federal races (office, state, district) for a cycle by state or ZIP code

commands.name: list-election-dates
commands.summary: List upcoming (or past) federal election dates by state, office and election type

commands.name: list-calendar-dates
commands.summary: List FEC calendar events (reporting deadlines, IE periods, elections, meetings) in a date range

commands.name: list-contributions-by-state
commands.summary: Break down a candidate's itemized individual contributions by contributor state (total and count per state)

commands.name: get-contributions-by-state-total
commands.summary: Get a candidate's total itemized individual contributions summed across all states

commands.name: list-contributions-by-size
commands.summary: Break down a candidate's individual contributions by contribution size bucket (0 = unitemized under $200, 200, 500, 1000, 2000)

commands.name: list-receipts
commands.summary: List itemized receipts (Schedule A, e.g. individual contributions) to a committee, newest first, with contributor name, employer and amount

commands.name: list-disbursements
commands.summary: List itemized disbursements (Schedule B) made by a committee, newest first, with recipient, purpose and amount

commands.name: list-disbursements-by-recipient
commands.summary: Aggregate a committee's spending by payee name (top vendors and recipients with totals and percentage of spending)

commands.name: list-disbursements-to-committees
commands.summary: Aggregate a committee's transfers and contributions to other registered committees by recipient committee ID

commands.name: list-filings
commands.summary: List processed FEC filings (reports, statements, notices) for a committee or candidate, with links to PDFs

commands.name: list-efile-filings
commands.summary: List raw electronic filings for a committee received since a date, including ones not yet processed, with PDF/CSV/.fec links

commands.name: list-independent-expenditures-by-candida
commands.summary: List outside spending (independent expenditures, Schedule E) supporting or opposing candidates, aggregated by spender, for a candidate or a whole race

commands.name: list-communication-costs-by-candidate
commands.summary: List communication costs (corporate or union internal communications) for or against candidates, aggregated by organization

commands.name: get-state-election-offices
commands.summary: Get a state's election offices (ballot access and campaign finance) with addresses, phones and websites

commands.name: get-advisory-opinion
commands.summary: Get an FEC advisory opinion's documents (date, title, PDF link) by AO number

commands.name: export-election-candidates
commands.summary: Queue a CSV export of a race's candidate financial totals. This creates a server-side download task.
